results.user: OK... I'll try the breathing thing first.
results.visibleReply:
Good. Let's do this slowly.

Breathe in gently — just to a comfortable fullness, no forcing. Then let the breath out slowly, longer than the in. As you breathe out, see if you can let your shoulders drop just a little.

Do that two or three times.

And while you breathe — just notice the stone in your chest. You don't have to do anything with it. Just let it be there while you breathe around it.

Take your time. Tell me what you notice when you're ready.
